cases.case_label: De novo exonic Alu in CSDE1
cases.disease: Autism spectrum disorder with intellectual disability and macrocephaly
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo Alu insertion (15-bp TSD, polyA tail) in an exon of the LoF-intolerant ASD gene CSDE1 was found in a Simons Simplex Collection proband and considered likely pathogenic as an exonic disruption; a single clipped read in the mother raised possible low-level maternal mosaicism.
cases.quote: We also detected exonic TEIs in LoF genes in cases, including a causal exonic Alu insertion in CSDE1, known ASD gene [22].
